name: Harley-Davidson Shovelhead FLH
engine: 1200 or 1340 cc air-cooled Shovelhead V-twin, one carb, chain drive
intro: The Shovelhead big twin. Expect oil leaks and valve guide wear. Later bikes got the better oil pump and guides.

add.title: Check the valve guides
add.instructions: Look for blue smoke on start-up and oil on the plugs. Wiggle-test the valves in the guides with the heads off.
add.reason: Valves and guides were a weak spot, especially on AMF-era engines.

add.title: Re-torque fasteners
add.instructions: Go over every engine mount, bracket and fender bolt and tighten to spec. These engines shake bolts loose.
add.reason: Loose bolts lead to cracked brackets and lost parts.

H: For leaks, start with a leak-down test, then check head gaskets, rocker covers and the oil pump.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Oil leaks
known.what: Leaks from head gaskets, rocker covers and the oil pump are so common owners call it the Shovelhead drip.
